69	    // MARK: - Episode Notifications

71	    func rescheduleEpisodeNotifications(items: [WatchlistItem]) async {
72	        guard shouldScheduleNotifications() else { return }
73	
74	        let center = UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
75	
76	        // Remove all existing episode notifications
77	        let pendingRequests = await center.pendingNotificationRequests()
78	        let episodeIds = pendingRequests
79	            .filter { $0.identifier.hasPrefix("episode-") }
80	            .map(\.identifier)
81	        center.removePendingNotificationRequests(withIdentifiers: episodeIds)
82	
83	        // Build content for all eligible episodes
84	        var contentItems: [(content: NotificationContent, airDate: Date)] = []
85	        for item in items where item.isTVShow {
86	            guard let airDate = item.nextEpisodeDate else { continue }
87	
88	            guard let content = NotificationContentBuilder.episodeNotification(
89	                mediaId: item.mediaId,
90	                title: item.title,
91	                seasonNumber: item.nextSeasonNumber,
92	                episodeNumber: item.nextEpisodeNumber,
93	                episodeName: item.nextEpisodeName,
94	                airDate: airDate
95	            ) else { continue }
96	
97	            contentItems.append((content, airDate))
98	        }
99	
100	        // Schedule chronologically so badge values (1, 2, 3...) match air order
101	        let sortedItems = contentItems.sorted { $0.airDate < $1.airDate }
102	        var badgeOffset = 0
103	        for (content, airDate) in sortedItems {
104	            if airDate > lastOpenedDate {
105	                badgeOffset += 1
106	                await scheduleNotification(content, badgeCount: badgeOffset)
107	            } else {
108	                await scheduleNotification(content)
109	            }
110	        }
111	    }
112	
113	    // MARK: - Movie Availability Notifications
114	
115	    func notifyMovieAvailable(item: WatchlistItem, serviceName: String) async {
116	        guard shouldScheduleNotifications() else { return }
117	
118	        let content = NotificationContentBuilder.movieAvailableNotification(
119	            mediaId: item.mediaId,
120	            title: item.title,
121	            serviceName: serviceName
122	        )
123	
124	        // Count pending episode notifications that will fire after lastOpenedDate
125	        let center = UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
126	        let pendingRequests = await center.pendingNotificationRequests()
127	        let episodeCount = pendingRequests
128	            .filter { $0.identifier.hasPrefix("episode-") }
129	            .compactMap { $0.trigger as? UNCalendarNotificationTrigger }
130	            .compactMap { (trigger: UNCalendarNotificationTrigger) -> Date? in
131	                Calendar.current.date(from: trigger.dateComponents)
132	            }
133	            .filter { $0 > lastOpenedDate }
134	            .count
135	
136	        await scheduleNotification(content, badgeCount: episodeCount + 1)
137	    }
138	
139	    // MARK: - Scheduling
140	
141	    private func scheduleNotification(_ content: NotificationContent, badgeCount: Int? = nil) async {
142	        let notificationContent = UNMutableNotificationContent()
143	        notificationContent.title = content.title
144	        notificationContent.body = content.body
145	        notificationContent.categoryIdentifier = content.categoryIdentifier
146	        notificationContent.threadIdentifier = content.threadIdentifier
147	        notificationContent.sound = .default
148	        notificationContent.userInfo = [
149	            "mediaId": content.mediaId,
150	            "mediaType": content.mediaType
151	        ]
152	
153	        if let badgeCount {
154	            notificationContent.badge = NSNumber(value: badgeCount)
155	        }
156	
157	        // Create trigger
158	        let trigger: UNNotificationTrigger?
159	        if let triggerDate = content.triggerDate {
160	            let components = Calendar.current.dateComponents(
161	                [.year, .month, .day, .hour, .minute],
162	                from: triggerDate
163	            )
164	            trigger = UNCalendarNotificationTrigger(dateMatching: components, repeats: false)
165	        } else {
166	            // Immediate delivery (for movie availability)
167	            trigger = nil
168	        }
169	
170	        let request = UNNotificationRequest(
171	            identifier: content.identifier,
172	            content: notificationContent,
173	            trigger: trigger
174	        )
175	
176	        do {
177	            try await UNUserNotificationCenter.current().add(request)
178	        } catch {
179	            // Notification scheduling failed — non-fatal
180	        }
181	    }
182

187	        try? await UNUserNotificationCenter.current().setBadgeCount(0)
188	    }
189

191

193	        UNUserNotificationCenter.current().removeAllPendingNotificationRequests()
194	        Task { await clearBadge() }
